text:
kevin-sales: Hey team :wave: — Quick sync for the Pavo enterprise trial. Sales asked for a 2-week focused integration window starting Mon. Need to confirm: 1) exact deliverables for the POC (API contract, auth, sample prompts), 2) owners for each deliverable, 3) any infra or compliance blockers. Can owners pls ack and call out blockers?

ashley-se: Ack. From SE side we need: staging API key + network allowlist, sample prompt set, and a short eval plan (SLOs: <300ms p95 for simple generations). I can own eval plan + prompt set.

devon-eng: I can own the API contract and sample client snippets. Need staging creds and the expected token/embedding throughput to estimate batching config. Also there's an open PR altering the inference route: PR #3456 — if that lands we need to adjust the client example.

maria-pm: I'll own success criteria doc + acceptance checklist. Deadline for owners to confirm by EOD Thu so sales can lock the window.

sam-sre: Heads up — for private VPC trial we need an IP allowlist and an approval from infra for cross-account peering. If Pavo needs dedicated nodes we'll need a week lead time. Any chance this is hosted-only?

kevin-sales: Pavo prefers hosted but will accept dedicated if required. For first pass they want hosted with data retention controls. Kevin -> I'll confirm with them today about dedicated requirement.

ashley-se: For hosted path we still need a staging key and network info. Can SRE create a short-lived demo key? @sam-sre

sam-sre: Yep, can issue a 7-day staging key. I'll need a ticket with customer CIDR and required ports (443 outbound).

devon-eng: Linking the PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/3456 — reviewer @maria-pm, @ashley-se. If we merge, example client needs to switch to /v2/streaming-gen endpoint. I can post a patch to the sample once we have final API shape.

ashley-se: I'll review PR today. Also: sample prompt set (10 prompts) almost ready — will drop them in the shared drive by EOD.

maria-pm: Action items summary: - Ashley: prompt set + eval plan (due Thu EOD) - Devon: API client examples + PR follow-up (due Fri) - Sam: staging key + allowlist ticket (create by Wed) - Kevin: confirm hosted vs dedicated with Pavo (today) Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept.

kevin-sales: Confirmed hosted-first approach with Pavo. They signed off on retention controls and are okay with short-lived staging creds. I'll email security contact and loop infra approvals.

sam-sre: Created ticket INF-2147 for staging key & allowlist. Devon, please drop customer CIDR in the ticket.

devon-eng: Done — put CIDR and expected tokens/sec in INF-2147. Also pinging @ashley-se for sample prompt edge cases.

ashley-se: Got it, I'll flag any prompt safety concerns. Also will include expected eval metrics so we can validate post-integration.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted a note: "staging env created: stg-pavo-001 — creds to be shared to owners after INF-2147 approval"

kevin-sales: Great. Last ask — can we get a quick code-review ping when sample client is ready? devon please tag #eng-reviews and cc me. We want to start dry-run by next Tue.

devon-eng: Will do. Targeting sample client PR by Fri morning and will add reviewers.

maria-pm: Thanks everyone — I'll collate into a single acceptance checklist and share in the Pavo trial doc. If anything changes ping here.

kevin-sales: Thanks all :rocket: 

(threads end)
